content:
sana: Quick follow-up on the postmortem. We need to assign owners and target dates for the action items.

oscar: I'll take the incident metric work (action 1). Will create a ticket and set ETA.

mei: I'll own the runbook rewrite (action 2) and add an automated smoke test.

sana: Great. Can we standardize RACI in the ticket description? R=owner, A=team lead, C=SRE, I=Support.

oscar: Agree. Created REDWOOD-9001 for metric alerting: https://jira.company/REDWOOD-9001. ETA 2026-04-07. Tagged component=postmortem.

mei: Created REDWOOD-9002 for runbook + tests: https://jira.company/REDWOOD-9002. ETA 2026-04-05. I'll add a checklist and link to the postmortem.

sana: Can folks add blockers or needed resources in the ticket comments. Also add the postmortem doc link.

ticketbot: Reminder: use labels `postmortem` and `remediation-owner` on tickets.

oscar: Noted. I'll follow up with eng-monitoring for quota on the new metric.

mei: If runbook needs more time, I'll flag it in REDWOOD-9002.

sana: Thanks all. I'll update the postmortem with owners and close this thread once both tickets show progress.
